authority: Only existing CompoundCoordinator commits native state; reference controller can propose allocation, renderer cannot resume callers

state_axes.region_state: Separate diagnostic field; UNASSESSED absent eligible measurement
state_axes.semantic_outcome: Native checked result and commitment status, never inferred from flow

quantity_contract.window: one explicitly identified host-step observation window; event interval and monotonic wall interval retained separately
quantity_contract.I_predicted: Pinned compiler exact attention_flow on separately declared design V and R before execution; no measured-resistance fit, empirical calibration or valid residual claim.
quantity_contract.I_allocated: Integer grant for at most one permitted next native stage in this first profile; allocation alone creates no event
quantity_contract.I_executed: CPython call events for the pinned CompoundMachine.advance code object and machine identity; I_attempted separately records dispatch attempts.
quantity_contract.other_costs: Native instruction/checker reservations, actual primitive/check counts, wall time and orchestration overhead remain separate recorded channels; do not call one transition a universal or complete compute unit
quantity_contract.independence: Observe executor trace after invocation, not by copying grant or substituting Ohm output
quantity_contract.calibration: None supplied; no universal attention claim or ASOM pass; signed residual unavailable unless all eligibility/unit/window/source conditions are met
quantity_contract.actual_primitive_work: Existing native work_from_catalog joined by run/tick/intent and sealed event ID/hash. Measured totals separate from policy reservations. Missing counters yield JOINED_PARTIAL and complete_totals=null. Ordinary reasoning and orchestration are outside native primitive scope.

first_actuator.operation: CompoundMachine.advance(allow_acquisition=...) through one typed, budget-masked host-step adapter
first_actuator.scope: Positive grant permits one invocation of the existing native host; an invocation can produce multiple native transition events. Zero/disabled grant performs no advance. Native instruction/checker budgets remain binding.
first_actuator.native_budget: Current native budget remains binding; wrapper cannot reset, refund or exceed it; exact deeper work still charged by coordinator

board_profile.parent_transformation: Existing compound root call and checked application
board_profile.prerequisite_acquisition: Existing primitive/compound construction, qualification and installation intents
board_profile.verification_commit: Existing checked proof and authorized commitment; no answer supplied by adapter
board_profile.pcba_boundary: Parse and check declared supported boards with existing reader; only explicitly mapped native operations execute; all other constructs refused as unsupported
board_profile.implementation: Three exact static PCBA source templates with explicit native operation allowlists; no general circuit execution.

return_contract.atlas: Snapshot-bound node/frame address plus authoritative native continuation reference. Profile coordinates and screen layout cannot select recipients. No new live registry.
return_contract.repair: Qualified deltas pass existing coordinator; historical parent hash is not restored over legitimate repaired state
return_contract.budget: Use current charged ledger; saved remaining budget is history, not spend authority
return_contract.duplicates: Existing native stale/duplicate checks; atlas binding must not add second resume
return_contract.claim: Exact local return only; no exactly-once external effect assertion
return_contract.bias_version_basis: Suspension event pre_state_hash identifies saved native state including Bias; no separate native Bias counter exists.

receipt_integrity: Content digest and validated native event chain; no signature or independent authenticity claim.
